With the activation of the Dungeon Brides System, Ethan gains the power to inherit the bloodlines, abilities, and evolution paths of every dungeon boss who chooses him.
But bosses were never meant to love humans.
Guilds fear him. Nations watch him. Hunters hunt him.
And as more ancient queens awaken from their prisons, one truth becomes undeniable:
The man who marries the bosses will either rule the world… or destroy it.
starting-as-a-mechanical-hunter:
Gao Gong transmigrates into a Cyberpunk world and finds himself on the verge of death. Surrounded by at least a dozen of enemies, he awakens a system, and the first mission he receives is running for his life.
[Task: Life-taking Sprint]
Difficulty: Normal

strongest-lord-by-opening-blind-boxes:
Wang Yi transmigrated to a lord game world.
Here, opening blind boxes was originally a low-yield matter,
But under the blessing of his Dual Talent, all sorts of creative items came one after another.
A fishing rod becomes a fishing tower.
A Small Fireball with a six-meter diameter.
An Immortal Sect disciple at the 9999th level of Qi Refining.
How did an antique old car become a Bronze War Chariot?
Damn it, my resource point was accidentally Enhanced into a Resource Planet one billion light-years away.
“How come you have so many strange and bizarre things?”
“They are all from opening blind boxes!”
summoning-the-holy-sword:
During this chaotic era, the darkness engulfs all.
In a struggle of fire and death, despair shrouds the continent.
The line between fantasy and reality becomes blurred as a speckle of starlight penetrates the night sky.
But is it enough to reverse the downfall and fate? To regain the lost glory?
Rhode is a famed player in the game “Dragon Soul Continent”. There, he leads the strongest player guild in the game, the Starlight Guild. Just as he defeats the last BOSS, the Void Dragon, he unexpectedly awoke in a world identical to the game.
As the Summoner Swordsman returns to the continent, waves will be cast in the rivers of fate. Can he face the coming chaos and avert the destruction of the continent?
sword-pilgrim:
Callius von Jervain.
A character who dies no matter what he does. A character who falls into a forced choice route where he can only die, no matter his choices up to that point. However, there is a single route where the character can live and play the game.
And I have to carve out that route somehow.
Because I’ve become Callius von Jervain in the game.
that-time-i-reincarnated-as-an-insect:
Reincarnated into the muddy guts of a cursed swamp as a tsetse fly, former office worker and master-level cynic Buzz Windbreaker quickly discovers that survival is both absurd and magnificent. The air is thick with poison, the predators are many-limbed and spell-woven, and the prey? Just as desperate as he is.
Yet with every drop of blood he drains from beast, beastkin, or unlucky mortal, Buzz unlocks fragments of an ancient arcane lattice that spirals beneath the skin of the world itself—a system of runes, incantation spirals, and primordial energy flows forgotten by even the highborn mages.
His evolution isn't just physical: it is architectural. Each new form is built like a spell—symmetrical, efficient, cruel. Wings shimmer with sigil arrays. Proboscises become siphons of mana and memory. Legs are sharpened to runic blades. Jokes sting. Death stings harder.
Soon, Buzz isn't just hunting. He is ascending.
the-alpha-who-regrets-losing-me:
Elara spent her entire life believing in one thing: the mate bond.
As the daughter of a low-ranking wolf, she knew her place in the pack. Quiet. Loyal. Invisible.
But everything changed the night the Moon Goddess revealed her mate.
The Alpha.
Kael Blackthorn.
The most powerful werewolf in the region. Cold, ruthless, and destined to rule.
For one brief moment, Elara believed fate had chosen her.
But Kael rejected her.
In front of the entire pack.
Humiliated and broken, Elara leaves the only home she has ever known. She disappears into the human world, determined to build a life where she is no longer defined by the mate who cast her aside.
Years pass.
And Elara changes.
She is no longer the quiet girl the pack once ignored.
She has power. Secrets. And a strength Kael never saw.
But when fate brings them together again, the bond between them awakens stronger than ever.
Only this time…
Elara refuses to be claimed.
And Kael realizes something terrifying.
Rejecting her may have been the greatest mistake of his life.
Because the woman he lost…
might be the only one capable of destroying him.
—or saving him.
the-guardian-system-the-strongest-summon:
Moments after sealing the biggest deal of his career, business owner Reidar Miller watched reality break.
Barely conscious, he hears a message blast through the chaos:
[EMERGENCY PROTOCOL ACTIVATED: The Last Will Framework has begun.]
[WARNING: All residents must seek immediate shelter. Terraforming begins in 60 seconds.]
The world twists. Asphalt cracks, physics unravels, and when Reidar awakens, death is everywhere, alongside monstrous new predators. Humanity’s fate is no longer in its own hands, but in the cold logic of a system no one understands. Now, survival means obeying rules written in code: levels, attributes, and deadly quests.
But Reidar has only one quest that matters: finding his family. Armed with powers he never asked for and commanding a growing army of monstrous creature, he'll bend the new laws of reality until he saves those he loves… or dies trying.
--Author's Comment--
Two chapters a day.
I am open to criticism as long as respect and constructive feedback are there. Actually, if you don't like or you are not interested in the book, would you be so kind to tell me why in a comment or review? I would like to understand if I have to improve something.…
the-heros-harem-is-trying-to-kill-him:
He was summoned to save the world… but his greatest threat isn’t the Demon King — it’s the women who love him.
Kai Veyron was just a delivery guy on Earth. But in the magical world of Aethria, he’s “The Chosen Hero” — gifted with ridiculous, godlike powers that he can’t control and didn’t ask for. He defeats monsters by sneezing, trips over relics that explode, and somehow charms every powerful woman he meets.
Now surrounded by a beautiful, deadly harem — a tsundere princess, a cold-blooded assassin, a genius mage, a seductive demoness, and a broken childhood friend — Kai thinks he’s finally found purpose, friendship… maybe even love.
But peace has a price.
As whispers of prophecy grow louder, the women begin to ask the unthinkable:
“What if the hero himself is the final calamity?”
They laugh with him by day… and plot his death by night.
And the worst part?
Kai already knows.
And he still protects them — even if it means his own downfall.
the-lucky-wife-reborn-in-the-90s-era-has:
# endoftheyear
Ji Yuanyuan was the type of person who would ruin a nicely dealt hand. She could have led a carefree life under her family and ex-husband’s protection. Alas, for the sake of a scum named Zhao Tianhua, she caused her mother to die an aggrieved death, her eldest brother to die in a foreign land, and her second brother to be run over by a car and had his head disembodied. She herself even died from childbirth in a shabby house at the countryside, and her baby was strangled to death by Zhao Tianhua. It was right before her death that she learned that her quiet ex-husband almost went mad searching for her.
Ji Yuanyuan was reborn back into the 90s era with extreme luck and a mysterious spatial ability. Since then, Ji Yuanyuan would find money on the ground, boars would run into trees on their own if she was lost in the wild, and her investments would all be successful… When the b*stard scum, Zhao Tianhua approached her again, Ji Yuanyuan kicked him away and latched onto her ex-husband’s leg instead. “Sir, please protect me.”
the-mafias-crybaby-wife:
# CRYBABY
A stranger! Lu An’an married a stranger! She heard that the man was extremely ugly and was a sex masochist despite his old age, but she could not reject him for the sake of her family.
On their wedding night, she thought about how she would leave her parents and brother completely in the future and spend the rest of her life living with the rumored sexual abuse…
The more Lu An’an thought about it, the more worried she became and the more terrified she became.
Her tears started gushing out even more violently. At this moment, a coarse and warm hand gently lifted her face.
“So beautiful, how did you know I like to see others cry?”
Oh, my god! He— he was truly a pervert! Lu An’an shivered.
Although he looked very young and good-looking, with deep-set eyes and thick eyelashes, and he had a smile like a sun, she would never tolerate such a terrifying hobby, much less cooperate with it!
“It’s just a business marriage between us. I hope we can… respect each other after we get married,” said Lu An’an after mustering up all her courage. Her tears turned the handsome man’s features blurry. However, Yan Yunge merely chuckled and kissed her tears away.
“Don’t worry, you’ll like it.…
the-man-with-hypnotic-powers-doesnt-hold:
Since I regressed, I decided not to hide my abilities.
“Hypnosis, huh? That’s amazing! Hypnotize me too!”
“How about me, instead of that sly fox? If you join our clan… you, you can hypnotize me!”
…Maybe I exposed it too much.
the-rejected-heiresss-possesive-tycoon-h:
“Will you marry me?”
As a metaphysics master, An Yan was humiliated by a rejected marriage proposal.
She turned around and grabbed the man with the best fate in the entire room to propose to him.
“Miss An, you'd better not regret this!”
In the blink of an eye, the hunter became the prey, and An Yan was a bit panicked.
She was truly cherished, but it was a possessiveness-driven affection that An Yan did not want.
It wasn't until he fell ill.
That she realized what was called deep affection was just a conspiracy.
Everyone says he is the Li Family's deity! Because of him, the Li Family flourished with riches and glory.
In reality, he is the Li Family's demon! He could potentially drag the entire family to irreversible doom at any moment.
the-ruthless-ceos-revenge-wife:
“What are you doing, Logan?”
Jean’s voice was sharp, but her body betrayed her leaning into the warmth of his breath as his lips traced a sinful path down her neck.
“You promised me a kiss every day, remember?” Logan murmured, his smirk curling against her skin.
“Or should I read the contract to you again?”
She should pull away. She knows this is wrong.
But resisting Logan Kingsley?
That was never in the plan.
------------------------------------------------------
Jean Adams has spent her entire life under the suffocating control of her powerful family, molded into the perfect daughter, the flawless businesswoman, and the untouchable heiress. But when her parents cross the final line, demanding she marry the very man who once shattered her, she refuses to be their pawn any longer. If they want a marriage, she’ll give them one. But on her terms.
Logan Kingsley, her sworn enemy. A self-made billionaire with a reputation for winning, Logan has spent years battling Jean in boardrooms and beyond. They have never seen eye to eye, their hatred simmering since childhood. But when Jean offers him a deal, a contract marriage that benefits them both, he doesn’t hesitate.…
the-s-class-omega-takes-over-again-bl:
[A sequel to The F-Class Healer Omega is a Villain]
In the city of Seoul, nothing had truly changed since the last surge of gates—at least, not after the last high energy levels had stablized. The country had settled into peace and harmony, guarded by an even stronger awakener… until the moment he became pregnant.
Two months into his pregnancy, that stability shattered. S-Class gates erupted across the country in an unprecedented stream, swallowing cities in panic and destruction. But these gates themselves weren’t the most troubling part.
The one who triggered them—undeniably an S+ Class awakener—had vanished without a trace. Gone. Offline. Watching the country burn from the shadows, planning something far more dangerous.
With the nation on the brink, the Central Bureau for Awakeners had no choice. They assigned the task of hunting down this mysterious new S+ Class to the strongest hunter in the country.
And who is the strongest hunter, you ask?
Of course… it’s me.
the-slayer-ascension-cursed-and-blessed:
35000+ Words Before Lock.
THE SLAYER ASCENSION.....
In a world where saints are worshipped and demons are hunted, power decides who is holy… and who is damned.
I am both.
A contradiction.
A human blessed by divinity…
yet bound to a demon that never sleeps and craves blood.
Hunted by demons.
Feared by the saints.
Watched by beings far older than gods.
There is only one way forward…
Ascension through slaughter.
Every demon I kill drags me further from humanity.
Every miracle I wield pushes me closer to damnation.
The devil believes he doesn’t feel fear.
I will make him prove himself wrong.
This is no hero’s story.
No one survives untouched.
Because this is…
THE SLAYER ASCENSION

the-youngest-hides-a-lot:

One Earth, one Immortal Realm, the difference is as vast as that between heaven and earth!
valkyrie-smash:
Sam Sanderson is envied by many for his job, however he himself didn't seem to like it much.
Due to his expertise in nanotechnology he was tasked with monitoring the state the Valkyries, humanity's strongest weapons who all just happen to be made into gorgeous females.
Forbidden from even touching any of them, Sam spends his days in agony watching flowers he couldn't hope to touch. However one day all of that seemed to change.
walking-away-while-pregnant-dear-ex-husb:
The day Elise Harper discovered she was pregnant again, her world shattered.
While she was grieving the child they had lost—slowly breaking apart under the weight of her sorrow—her husband, Dylan Bennett, had been building a secret life with another woman: the poor student Elise had once taken in and supported like family.
He celebrated the birth of his mistress’s son while his wife mourned alone.
The company Elise had poured her heart into had quietly become the other woman’s playground.
Even the dream home she believed symbolized their one and only love had been recreated for his new family.
In an instant, love turned to ash, leaving behind only betrayal and fury.
Hiding her pregnancy and swallowing her heartbreak, Elise hands Dylan the divorce papers without hesitation.
Certain she will come crawling back, he coldly warns her, “If you regret this and beg me now, I can pretend none of this ever happened.”
But this time, she simply walks away.
By the time Dylan realizes he’s about to lose the only woman he ever truly loved, it’s already too late.
The broken, grieving wife he abandoned is gone—replaced by a woman more brilliant, untouchable, and breathtaking than ever before.…
worldwide-awakening-my-soul-kinds-are-lo:
Wang Linchi transmigrates into a world where everyone has the chance to awaken after reaching adulthood. If the awakening is successful, they could obtain a power known as Soul Resemblance and could improve their abilities by embedding Soul Kinds.
On one hand, Wang is very lucky for his parents left him a good set of Soul Kinds.
On the other hand, he is out of luck because the Soul Kinds have been replaced by a low-quality one.
How he knows that? He saw with his own eyes as those five Soul Kinds were deposited.
